title: Memory
subtitle: What the coach knows about your household, in plain files you own. Every change is validated, previewed and recorded in a history you can revert.

questions.hint: An answer is only recorded. Turning it into a memory change is a separate, previewed step.
questions.emptyBody: New questions appear after a sync when the coach finds something it cannot infer.
questions.answerPlaceholder: Your answer, in your own words

proposals.terminalTitle: Accepting is done in your terminal, on purpose
proposals.terminalBody: The coach and document extraction can only propose changes. Nothing is written until you run the accept command shown on each proposal in your own terminal (it shows the same diff and asks for a typed confirmation). This page cannot accept for you, so nothing that reaches this page can write to your memory.
proposals.modified: modified after creation: it cannot be accepted
proposals.suspiciousBody: The source (a document, or data the coach read while proposing this) contains text that looks like an instruction. Check these fields yourself before accepting; each needs its own --confirm-field: {{paths}}.
proposals.notApplicable: Cannot be applied to the file as it is now: {{error}}
proposals.toAccept: To accept, run this in your own terminal:

reject.title: Reject this proposal?
reject.body: Nothing is written to your memory. The proposal is closed and cannot be accepted afterwards.

household.title: Household members
household.subtitle: Names stay on this machine; the coach sees aliases only.

events.title: Events
events.subtitle: Trips, works and projects. Tag transactions with them to keep their cost out of the usual month.

items.noContractBody: Add the ones behind your subscriptions to see their renewal dates.

annotations.title: Annotations
annotations.subtitle: Rules you taught: which transactions get which category, tags or event. The first match wins.
annotations.emptyBody: Fix a category in Transactions and choose “Remember with a memory annotation”.

history.title: Change history
history.subtitle: Every write to the memory, whoever made it (you in the app, the CLI, the coach). Reverting is done in a terminal.
history.offBody: Set [memory] history = true in config.toml to record changes.
